biology.response: Magnitude of within-species genetically based quantitative trait change per generation, NOT demonstrated adaptive fitness. PROCEED genphen=Genetic records used; no claim about speciation or reaction-norm plasticity.
strict_predeclared_original_rate_QC: All seven original response ingredients present and finite, n1 and n2 >= 2, generations > 0, sd1 and sd2 > 0, positive finite pooled SD
Retain only original BasicCode 2026 criteria: abs(sd1/mean1)*100 between 0.1 and 1000 inclusive and abs(sd2/mean2)*100 between 0.1 and 1000 inclusive; zero denominator means CV infinite and fails
Do not alter these source-paper inclusion thresholds after outcomes; apply identically to all source plant genetic rows
No sign choice from observations: within-row magnitude abs(H) and continuous response log1p(abs(H)) (includes exact H=0; no epsilon or zero removal)

Aggregate one outcome per unique study+species+ordered original coordinate pair by median of all author-QC-qualified log1p(abs(H)) observations in that source pair; no cherry-picking traits, sexes, years or significance
No substitute Darwin or a second model when Haldanes do not qualify
biology.response_cluster: One study–species–original ordered geographic pair. Source duplicate trait measurements are NOT independent replication.
biology.study_species_preassigned_roles: Original 70-source components; never re-split after H presence or numeric QC

predictors.focal_history: One term: average of both site four-dim 21ka-to-0BP CHELSA climatic displacement magnitudes normalized by source training 0BP climate scales.
baseline_metadata_order: log1p(median positive generation count among pre-H source mask rows)
source proportions for six trait families growth, otherLH, othermorphology, phenology, physio, response; size is reference

model.first_shot: Two fixed L2-ridge weighted regressions, original baseline 21 features vs plus exactly one historical feature; no hyperparameter search
model.predictor_scaling: Training sample weighted means and SD, species-equal weights; zero-variance baseline predictors set standardized column zero; source history likewise uses training weighted SD
model.sample_weights: For each training source species, equal total weight across its retained unique comparison site pairs; likewise evaluation reports equal species mean heldout MSE
model.metric: Relative species-equal MSE improvement (MSE_base-MSE_history)/MSE_base across heldout species
model.uncertainty: 1,999 98.33% two-sided species-cluster bootstrap draws, seeded 20261114; positive if 98.33% lower confidence bound >0; negative if includes or is below zero

synthetic_pre_response_qualification.source_only_geometry: Only source presence mask and CHELSA/source metadata values; no rates
synthetic_pre_response_qualification.baseline_coef_generation: Deterministic signed 0.12 multiplier on first 11 training-standardised environmental controls and fixed 0.06 multiplier on ten methodological controls
